DEFINE
    VAR __DS0FilterTable =
        TREATAS({"N/A"}, 'Repair Order Lines'[Express Type])

    VAR __DS0FilterTable2 =
        FILTER(
            KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('MLM contracts'[Contract #])),
            'MLM contracts'[Contract #] = 38300657
        )

    VAR __DS0FilterTable3 =
        FILTER(
            KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Repair Order Lines'[Reason Instruction])),
            NOT(SEARCH("Loan", 'Repair Order Lines'[Reason Instruction], 1, 0) >= 1)
        )

    VAR __DS0FilterTable4 =
        FILTER(
            KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Repair Order Lines'[Instruction Type])),
            AND(
                'Repair Order Lines'[Instruction Type] <> "Ship Only",
                'Repair Order Lines'[Instruction Type] <> "Cancelled"
            )
        )

    VAR __Today =
        TODAY()

    VAR __StartDate =
        DATE(
            YEAR(__Today) - IF(MONTH(__Today) < 11, 1, 0),
            11,
            1
        )

    VAR __EndDate =
        EDATE(__StartDate, 12)

    VAR __DS0FilterTable5 =
        FILTER(
            KEEPFILTERS(
                VALUES('Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date Calendar Month Start Date])
            ),
            'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date Calendar Month Start Date] >= __StartDate
                && 'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date Calendar Month Start Date] < __EndDate
        )

    VAR __DS0FilterTable6 =
        FILTER(
            KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[Fault Type])),
            SEARCH("Damage", 'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[Fault Type], 1, 0) >= 1
        )

    VAR __DS0FilterTable7 =
        FILTER(
            KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Repair Order Lines'[Product Family])),
            'Repair Order Lines'[Product Family] = "TC57XX"
        )

    VAR __DS0Core =
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
                'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date Calendar Month Start Date],
                "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
            ),
            __DS0FilterTable,
            __DS0FilterTable2,
            __DS0FilterTable3,
            __DS0FilterTable4,
            __DS0FilterTable5,
            __DS0FilterTable6,
            __DS0FilterTable7,
            "Damage", '_RepairDataMeasures'[1_Monthly_Count 38300657],
            "Damage Allowance", '_RepairDataMeasures'[3_Max_Damage_Allowance38300657]
        )

    VAR __DS0PrimaryShowAll =
        ADDMISSINGITEMS(
            'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date Calendar Month Start Date],
            __DS0Core,
            ROLLUPISSUBTOTAL(
                'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date Calendar Month Start Date],
                [IsGrandTotalRowTotal]
            ),
            __DS0FilterTable,
            __DS0FilterTable2,
            __DS0FilterTable3,
            __DS0FilterTable4,
            __DS0FilterTable5,
            __DS0FilterTable6,
            __DS0FilterTable7
        )

    __DS0PrimaryShowAll

    [IsGrandTotalRowTotal] ASC,
    'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date Calendar Month Start Date] ASC
